Extension 2: Event study





• This new regression allows us to estimate the “dynamic”
  treatment effect
• Parallel trends assumption for DD is more likely to hold over a
  shorter time-window
• In the long-run, many other things may happen that could
  confound the effect of the treatment
• Should be cautious to extrapolate short-term effects to long-term
  effect
